items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 29 Sep 2026, sent by ordinary post by an authority: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG (as amended, applicable to items posted since 2025) it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 3 Oct 2026; for authority letters this day is not shifted for falling on a Saturday/holiday (Tag der Deutschen Einheit). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs from the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), starting 4 Oct 2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same date, Tue 3 Nov 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is a normal working day in SH, so no further shift applies.

items.title: Keep the required vehicle logbook (Fahrtenbuch) for six months
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben. Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheides.
items.computation: The six-month logbook duty only begins once the notice becomes final (Bestandskraft), not on the letter's date. Bestandskraft is reached the day after the one-month Widerspruch period lapses unused, i.e. earliest on 4 Nov 2026 (the day after the 3 Nov 2026 deadline computed above) — but only if no Widerspruch is filed; if one is filed, Bestandskraft (and the start of the six months) is postponed until that remedy is finally resolved. Assuming the earliest plausible case (no Widerspruch filed), the six-month period would run from 4 Nov 2026 (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, day after the triggering event) and end on the corresponding date six months later, Tue 4 May 2027 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). This end date is therefore only the earliest plausible reading and can move later.

warnings: The start (and thus the end) of the six-month logbook obligation depends on when the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft); this is only known for certain once the Widerspruch period passes unused or, if a Widerspruch is filed, once it is finally resolved — the 2027-05-04 end date given is only the earliest plausible estimate.
The bank details (IBAN) printed in the footer relate to the office's general account and are not tied to any payment demanded in this letter; no amount is due under this notice.
